description: Defines the working calendar for a Gantt chart: which days are non-working, public holidays, and working hours per day.

members.name: Holidays
members.description: Specific dates treated as public holidays (non-working).

members.name: NonWorkingDaysOfWeek
members.description: Days of the week treated as non-working. Default: Saturday + Sunday.

members.name: WorkDayEndHour
members.description: Hour at which the working day ends (0–23). Default: 17.

members.name: WorkDayStartHour
members.description: Hour at which the working day starts (0–23). Default: 8.
